info.title: Hello management API
info.description: hello-control REST API. Every route except version, openapi.json and auth/login requires the hello_session cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Secrets (device SIP secrets, API tokens, trunk passwords) appear only in the response that creates them; trunk passwords never appear in any response.

Create an API token; the token is returned only in this response

patch.summary: Change an extension's number or name
patch.description: Changing the number is 409 while a route refers to it (inbound destination or outbound source extension) (the message names the routes). Changes are checked as a whole routing configuration; a 400 lists failing fields. A 400 lists each failing field (number, name, externalNumber) in error.fields.

post.summary: Decide a call against the saved configuration without placing it
post.description: Writes nothing. Trunk usability comes from live state; when Valkey is unreachable every enabled trunk counts as usable and the trace says so. Trunk capacity (maxCalls) is not judged from cached counts: hello-sip decides it when the call is placed, and the trace says so for every candidate trunk with a limit.

get.summary: Cluster members, dependency health and configuration revision
get.description: Answers 200 with a dependency down, reporting it: members are empty while Valkey is unreachable, and the revision and lags are absent while PostgreSQL is.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Drain even if no READY SIP node would remain

post.description: Writes a drain request the node acts on within 5s, and audits it (actor and node; action drain, or drain-force when forced). 409 when draining would leave no READY SIP node, counting nodes with a pending drain request as not READY (repeat with ?force=true), or when the node is OFFLINE.

delete.description: Withdraws the drain request and audits it (action undrain). The node is not looked up, so a request for a node whose record has expired can still be withdrawn. 409 when no drain request exists (e.g. a node draining from SIGTERM). A node that has started exiting still exits.

get.description: The box is created with the extension; a missing box (an extension that predates it) is 404.

put.description: JSON with password and/or email, or multipart/form-data with the same fields plus optional `greeting` and `unreachable` WAV files (PCM, 5 MiB max); greetings land in the hello-voicemail bucket and the previous object is removed. At least one field is required. The password is stored as a hash and never returned.

200.description: Every box with its extension and message counts, by extension number

get.description: One row per box: the extension's number and name and its unheard and total messages, so a box list needs one request.
`box` is a voicemail box id (required); `unheard=true` keeps the messages not played yet.

post.description: An empty body marks heard; a body of `{"heard": false}` marks it unheard again.

200.description: Groups with their members in position order

post.description: Validation failures list each failing field (strategy, failureKind, members' positions, weights) in error.fields.

patch.description: Absent fields keep their value; a members list replaces the whole member list. The result is validated as a whole before it is stored.

put.description: The list is the complete configuration: every item is upserted and every code not in the list is removed. Codes are '*' plus 2-4 digits, or '##'; actions are forward_always, forward_busy, forward_no_answer, dnd_on, dnd_off, voicemail, blind_transfer, attended_transfer.

FieldError.description: One failing field. For a single trunk, route or extension create/PATCH, paths are relative to that item and use its JSON field names, e.g. "match", "trunks[0]", "numberTransform.template", "schedule.timeZone", "destinations[1].host". An error the whole-configuration check finds in another item keeps its full path in the routing configuration, e.g. "outbound[3].numberTransform.template" or "trunks[1].destinations" (index = position in that list as loaded), and a reorder reports "ids" or "ids[i]". Only errors a change introduces reject it: errors the saved configuration already had (for example after a manual edit) do not block fixing, deleting or unrelated changes.

Transform.description: Strip leading digits, then add a prefix, then replace the regex match with the template (${1}, ${name}). The empty object is identity.

regex.description: Go RE2 regular expression, at most 500 characters

template.description: Group references are ${1} or ${name}; a bare $1 is refused. Literal text is 0-9 + * #.

weight.description: Among equal priorities; 0 or omitted means 1

sourceCidrs.description: Source ranges the trunk may send from; at most /8 broad for IPv4 and /32 for IPv6, since every address in them can reach the inbound routes and UDP sources can be spoofed.

hasPassword.description: Whether a password is set; the password itself is never returned.
